stable.notes: See what is queued behind a session and cancel it: the pet card and the Sessions pane list each parked message with its place and text, with an × or Cancel while it is still waiting; a message the session already has says so. Includes 0.5.234: message a session from the pet, queue-and-deliver behind a running turn, 12-hour meeting times with a 24-hour pick under Settings, Advanced.

notice.title: Queued messages, listed and cancellable
notice.body: Under the pet's message card and the Sessions composer, what is parked behind a session now shows with its place in line and its text. Press × or Cancel while it is waiting. A message the session already has cannot be recalled; Control says so. Also since 0.5.234: message a session from the pet, and meeting times read 1:02 PM.
